newsitem.title: POLAND: SOCCER-WIDZEW LODZ V ATLELTICO MADRID TEAMS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-WIDZEW LODZ V ATLELTICO MADRID TEAMS.

text.p: Teams for Wednesday's European Cup Champions's League group B match between Widzew Lodz of Poland and Atletico Madrid of Spain:

Widzew Lodz: 1-Maciej Szczesny; 2-Miroslaw Szymkowiak, 5-Pawel Wojtala, 6-Marek Citko, 7-Radoslaw Michalski, 8-Jacek Dembinski, 12-Slawomir Majak, 13-Piotr Szarpak, 14-Marek Bajor, 15-Daniel Bogusz, 17-Andrzej Chalczuk.
Atletico Madrid: 1-Jose Molina; 3-Toni, 4-Solozabal, 6-Santi, 9-Juan Esnaider, 10-Milinko Pantic, 14-Diego Simeone, 15-Carlos Aguilera, 19-Kiko, 20-Geli, Radek Bejbl.
